tasks.description: Ensure all storage, transport, and rendering layers declare and honor UTF-8 to prevent character corruption. This includes database storage, API transport, and frontend rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs Unicode characters, when the data is stored and retrieved, then the characters are preserved correctly.

tasks.description: Modify the display name field to accept any Unicode script, including Latin, Japanese, Arabic, and others. Ensure no characters are stripped or mangled on save or render.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs a display name with Unicode characters, when the data is saved and rendered, then the characters are displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Modify the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior to support right-to-left languages like Arabic. Ensure mixed LTR/RTL content renders correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets their profile language to Arabic, when they view their profile, then the layout and text alignment are correct for RTL.

tasks.description: Modify the bio field to fully support emoji, including multi-codepoint sequences and ZWJ sequences. Ensure emoji persist round-trip and never corrupt into mojibake.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs emoji in their bio, when the data is saved and rendered, then the emoji are displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Modify the truncation logic to operate on grapheme clusters, never on raw bytes or half a surrogate pair. Ensure truncating a display name or bio never splits a character or emoji sequence in the middle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs a display name or bio that exceeds the maximum length, when the text is truncated, then the truncation is safe and does not split characters or emoji sequences.

tasks.description: Identify and fix any existing encoding issues in the storage, transport, and rendering layers to ensure UTF-8 is honored throughout the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user inputs Unicode characters, when the data is stored and retrieved, then the characters are preserved correctly and no encoding issues are observed.

tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit tests to cover the new functionality, including Unicode script support, RTL support, emoji support, and Unicode-safe truncation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of test cases, when the unit tests are run, then all tests pass and the functionality is verified.
